question: The topographic survey (ALP-EPC-00000-CV-RPT-0003) shows the Owner-levelled platform on average 66 mm below the +15.00 m stated in ER-02.01 / ALP-OWN-GEN-001, with 51 of 208 grid points outside +-0.10 m (systematic fall to the south, old warehouse foundations up to +0.25 m). Trimming to +15.00 m needs about 9,300 m3 of structural fill. Please confirm (a) the acceptance tolerance of the Owner platform and whether the fill below -0.10 m is at the Owner cost, or (b) that the Contractor may set the finished floor and road levels on the as-surveyed platform with local trimming only.
response: (b) with a limit. The Owner's earthworks contract levelled the platform to +15.00 m +- 0.15 m; the survey shows the platform within that tolerance except the south edge strip (N 0-25 m, 17 points), the old warehouse foundations (2 points; demolition is Contractor scope anyway) and three isolated points 1-3 cm beyond the band. The Contractor sets finished floor and road levels on the as-surveyed platform with local trimming only; structural fill needed below +14.85 m is paid by the Owner at the unit rate of the Price Schedule against a joint survey.
subject: Owner platform levels below +15.00 m (survey ALP-SUR-TOP-001)
